title: Agent Kallus
subtitle: Seeking the Rebels
text:
Ambush (After you play this unit, he may ready and attack an enemy unit.)

When another unique unit is defeated: You may draw a card. Use this ability only once each round.
rules:
If Agent Kallus is defeated simultaneously with other unique units, you still may draw a card.
Ambush is an ability that triggers at the same time as “When Played” abilities. If there is no enemy unit that can be attacked, the unit does not ready.
(ERRATA) Templating update: “Unique” becomes “<uq>”.
